title: Livestock Treatment Form
subtitle: Livestock Treatment: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Livestock Treatment Form covers animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition. The livestock care record owner records Livestock Treatment activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Livestock Treatment Form keeps Livestock Treatment exceptions visible until the livestock care record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Livestock Treatment Form at pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location. Document animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition identity before Livestock Treatment begins. Compare animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition findings with stated Livestock Treatment criteria; route unresolved Livestock Treatment issues to veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer. For Livestock Treatment Form, confirm requirements for Livestock Treatment. Ask veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer to review Livestock Treatment conditions beyond the livestock care record owner's role.
